misty-valley-station.prompt: A small abandoned railway station on a misty valley floor, snow-dusted platform, wooden shelter with a dark open doorway, tracks curving into the fog, pine hills beyond

spots.label: track-curves
spots.hint: Follows the rails into the fog toward the distant hills.

spots.label: shed-door
spots.hint: An open doorway in the small wooden shelter to step inside.

platform-shelter.prompt: Inside the wooden station shelter: a narrow room with a bench, an old stove, a window looking out at fog, a door at the back standing ajar

spots.label: open door
spots.hint: step outside to the bright room beyond

frozen-tracks.prompt: Following the railway tracks along the valley floor into freezing fog, snow between the sleepers, a stone culvert opening under the embankment

spots.label: station door
spots.hint: Enter the wooden hut beside the tracks

station-loft.prompt: A dusty station loft under rafters, stacked crates, a small round window with pale light, wooden stairs leading down

culvert-mouth.prompt: The mouth of a stone culvert beneath a railway embankment, dark water running out, moss on the stones, faint light visible deep inside
